approvalEvent.summary: Approve Motion System V1 creative direction, product-native choreography, Hybrid motion ownership, and reduced-motion philosophy for production development. Production implementation and final Visual System approval remain open.

humanFindings: Runtime event motion now changes the owning product surface and leaves useful structure behind.
Approval is the signature authority transition: Threshold enters because authority changes, not as general decoration.
Execution resolves into durable Decision → Action → Verified → History state rather than celebration.
Mobile continuity is demonstrated by a restrained project/thread navigation sheet rather than desktop-style navigation.
Counterpoint, Decision Spine, and Threshold retain non-overlapping motion responsibilities.
Reduced-motion philosophy preserves state meaning while removing nonessential movement.
